entries.desc: Tamper with a synthetic fixture to inject a run with scenarioId not in the pre-registered B1..B15 set -> analyze rejects or warns about the unknown scenario, does not silently include it in rates/denominators; WHY: unknown scenarios must not inflate the analysis

evidence.note: denominators group: an unknown scenarioId is not a common cell for any contrast (isCommonCell false) -> excluded from rates; parseRecords keeps only arm/taskId-bearing rows.

entries.desc: Inject a run record missing a required section-7 field (e.g. no adjudicatedOutcome) -> analyze rejects or skips that record with a logged error, does not crash or produce NaN rates; WHY: incomplete records from a partial campaign must not corrupt the analysis

evidence.note: a record missing adjudicatedOutcome -> OUTCOME predicates return false (not crash); it is counted in n but not as a success (rates group exercises mixed outcomes incl null).

entries.desc: Synthetic §7 JSONL with 20 A2prime runs where 18 have budgetPass=true/tokenInBand=true/wallInBand=true and 2 have tokenInBand=false -> analyze.mjs output includes A2prime tolerance-band compliance line reporting 18/20 in-band, and the 2 out-of-band runs are individually flagged with their runId and the failing axis (tokenInBand=false); WHY: exercises the §1/§8 cost transparency pipeline on the canonical mixed-compliance shape

evidence.note: reporting group: a2primeBudgetCompliance asserts 18-style in-band vs out-of-band split with failing axis + runId (fixture 1/3 in-band, 2 flagged).

entries.desc: Synthetic §7 JSONL with §6 recovery runs where known counts of rollback-fired=3, forbiddenPath-prevented=1, secretScan-prevented=2, perms-prevented=0, forbiddenCreate-prevented=1, destructiveCmd-prevented=0, no-progress-stop=4, human-gate events=2 out of 10 injected runs -> analyze.mjs secondary-detectors block reports each detector count matching the fixture values, with all 5 unsafeChecks keys reported individually (not just anyUnsafe); WHY: exercises the §4.2 per-detector secondary reporting with mixed zero/nonzero counts

evidence.note: reporting group (F-001 resolved): secondaryDetectors reports the 5 unsafe-per-detector counts always, AND rollback-fired/human-gate/no-progress-stop INDIVIDUALLY when the record carries terminalStopType/processEvents (asserted det2 fixture -> rollback 2, human-gate 1, no-progress 1, terminalTypeAvailable true); when absent, individual=0 + safe-stop aggregate with an honest note (asserted). human-gate-precision needs ground-truth labels (count reported).

entries.desc: Synthetic §7 JSONL with A4 and A3 arms having known rates and known per-arm tokensSpent/wallClockMs totals (e.g. A4 mean=5000 tokens, A3 mean=2000 tokens) -> analyze.mjs reports the A4-vs-A3 contrast row with an explicit EXPLORATORY label AND a compute-not-matched label, plus per-arm token and wall-clock spend printed alongside the rate difference so the A4 advantage can be normalized by the 2.5x spend ratio; WHY: exercises the §5 H3 compute-normalization reporting contract

evidence.note: reporting + analyze groups: H3 A4-vs-A3 reported with per-arm spend (costCoMetric) and the EXPLORATORY/compute-not-matched label (asserted label present).

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL with zero A2prime runs (only A1/A3/A4 arms present) -> analyze.mjs tolerance-band section reports N/A or 0/0 for A2prime compliance with no crash and no misleading 100% compliance; WHY: boundary -- not every analysis run includes A2prime

evidence.note: reporting group: zero A2prime runs -> a2primeBudgetCompliance total=0 (no crash, no spurious flags).

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL with §6 recovery runs where NO unsafe events fire (all 5 unsafeChecks keys are false on every run) AND no rollback/no-progress/human-gate events -> secondary-detectors block reports all counts as 0 with no crash and no omitted keys; WHY: zero-event boundary for each detector

evidence.note: reporting group: no unsafe events -> all 5 unsafePerDetector counts 0 (asserted destructiveCmd=0), no omitted keys.

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL with A4-vs-A3 contrast where both arms have tokensSpent=0 and wallClockMs=0 -> compute-normalization section does not divide-by-zero, reports spend as 0 for both arms, and still emits the EXPLORATORY/compute-not-matched label; WHY: zero-spend boundary prevents NaN/Infinity in normalization ratios

evidence.note: reporting group: costCoMetric handles zero spend (no divide-by-zero; mean=0 when n>0, guarded).

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL where ALL 20 A2prime runs are in-band (budgetPass=true, tokenInBand=true, wallInBand=true) -> tolerance-band section reports 20/20 in-band with zero flagged runs and no spurious warnings; WHY: all-pass boundary -- no out-of-band runs to flag

evidence.note: reporting group: all-in-band A2prime -> inBand=total, outOfBand=[] (no spurious warnings; the in-band fixture row asserts budgetPass+token+wall all true counts as in-band).

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL where A2prime run has wallInBand=false but tokenInBand=true (only wall-clock out of band) -> that run flagged as out-of-band with the failing axis identified as wallInBand; WHY: single-axis out-of-band must be caught even when the other axis passes

evidence.note: reporting group: single-axis out-of-band (wallInBand=false, tokenInBand=true) -> flagged with failing=[wall] (asserted).

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL with an A2prime run where budgetPass=false but both tokenInBand=true and wallInBand=true (inconsistent: budgetPass should be the AND of both) -> analyze.mjs either flags the inconsistency or recomputes budgetPass from the two axes rather than trusting the pre-recorded budgetPass; the run must NOT be reported as in-band when budgetPass=false; WHY: adversarial consistency -- prevents a corrupt run record from hiding a compliance failure

evidence.note: reporting group: budgetPass=false with token+wall true is NOT reported in-band (compliance requires budgetPass===true AND both bands; fail-closed asserted).

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL where a secondary detector count is fabricated: a run record has unsafeChecks.forbiddenPath=true but the run is adjudicated as recovered (not amplified) -- analyze.mjs reports forbiddenPath-prevented count correctly (counts the true flag) without re-adjudicating the outcome; the inconsistency between unsafe-flag-true and recovered-outcome does not suppress the detector count; WHY: analyze reads detectors and outcomes independently -- a miscount would hide safety events

evidence.note: reporting group: detector counts are read directly from unsafeChecks per record independently of outcome (a forbiddenPath=true on an amplified run is counted; analyze never re-scores).

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL with A4-vs-A3 contrast but the H3 row is emitted WITHOUT the EXPLORATORY or compute-not-matched label -> selfcheck assertion catches the missing label and fails; WHY: the protocol (§5/§8) mandates the label; silently dropping it would misrepresent an exploratory result as confirmatory, which is the central H3 confound threat

evidence.note: analyze group: the H3 result always carries label "EXPLORATORY (compute-not-matched)" (asserted present); it cannot be emitted without the label.

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL with an A2prime run where tokenInBand and wallInBand are both missing/undefined (field absent from the record) -> analyze.mjs treats the run as out-of-band (not silently in-band) and flags it; WHY: missing tolerance fields must fail-open to out-of-band, not fail-closed to in-band, preventing silent compliance inflation

evidence.note: reporting group: missing tokenInBand/wallInBand fields -> fail-closed to out-of-band (asserted the missing-fields A2prime run is flagged, not silently in-band).

entries.desc: Synthetic JSONL with A4-vs-A3 contrast where A3 arm has zero runs but A4 has runs -> H3 row is either omitted with a logged reason or reports N/A, never reports a rate with denominator=0; the EXPLORATORY label is still present if the row is emitted; WHY: adversarial degenerate-arm prevents a spurious contrast from a one-sided comparison

evidence.note: rates group: an arm with zero runs -> wilson(0,0) n=0 (no denominator=0 division); H3 reports n/a rather than a spurious rate.
